background: I am logged in as an Organization Administrator
I am on the Service Provider page

scenarios.title: Verify login with valid Organization Administrator credentials
preconditions: I am on the login page
actions: I enter valid Organization Administrator credentials
I click the Login button
expectedResults: I should be logged in successfully
I should be redirected to the Service Provider page

scenarios.title: Verify login with invalid credentials
preconditions: I am on the login page
actions: I enter invalid login credentials
I click the Login button
expectedResults: I should not be logged in
I should remain on the login page
the appropriate login error message should be displayed

scenarios.title: Verify navigation to the Locations section
preconditions: I am logged in as an Organization Administrator
I am on the Service Provider page
actions: I click the Locations icon
expectedResults: the Locations section should be displayed
the Location list and available actions should be visible

scenarios.title: Create a Location with valid details
actions: I select "Add Location"
I enter all required Location details
I configure the Active status
I select "Create Location"
expectedResults: the Location should be created successfully
the Location should appear in the Location list with the correct details

scenarios.title: Create a Location with each supported Location Type
actions: I select "Add Location"
I enter all required Location details
I select "<Location Type>" as the Location Type
I select "Create Location"
expectedResults: the Location should be created successfully
the selected Location Type should be displayed correctly

scenarios.title: Verify location creation with an empty Location Name
preconditions: the user is on the Add Location page
actions: the user leaves the Location Name field empty
enters all other required details
clicks the Create Location button
expectedResults: the location should not be created
an appropriate validation message should be displayed

scenarios.title: Verify location creation with whitespace-only Location Name
preconditions: the user is on the Add Location page
actions: the user enters only whitespace in the Location Name field
enters all other required details
clicks the Create Location button
expectedResults: the location should not be created
an appropriate validation message should be displayed

scenarios.title: Verify Location Name with numeric characters
preconditions: the user is on the Add Location page
actions: the user enters a Location Name containing numbers
enters all other required details
clicks the Create Location button
expectedResults: the location should be created successfully

scenarios.title: Verify Location Name with numeric-only input

scenarios.title: Verify Location Name character length validation
preconditions: the user is on the Add Location page
actions: the user enters a Location Name within the permitted character limit
enters all other required details
clicks the Create Location button
expectedResults: the system should validate the Location Name according to the configured character limit
display an appropriate validation message if the limit is exceeded
create the location if all validation rules are satisfied

I enter valid values in all other required fields
I click the Create Location button
expectedResults: the location should be created successfully
the entered address should be displayed in the Locations list

scenarios.title: Validate mandatory fields during Location creation
actions: I select "Add Location"
I leave the mandatory fields empty
I select "Create Location"
expectedResults: the Location should not be created
appropriate validation messages should be displayed

scenarios.title: Handle duplicate Location details
preconditions: a Location with an existing name or ODS Code is available
actions: I select "Add Location"
I enter duplicate Location details
I select "Create Location"
expectedResults: the application should handle duplicate values according to the business rules
duplicate records should not be created if duplicates are prohibited

scenarios.title: Cancel Location creation
actions: I select "Add Location"
I enter Location details
I select "Cancel"
expectedResults: the creation form should close
the new Location should not be created

scenarios.title: Edit an existing Location and save changes
preconditions: an existing Location is available
actions: I select the Edit icon for the Location
I update the Location details
I select "Save"
I reopen the Location
expectedResults: the changes should be saved successfully
the updated details should appear in the Location list
the updated details should be retained

scenarios.title: Discard unsaved changes to a Location
preconditions: an existing Location is available
actions: I select the Edit icon for the Location
I modify the Location details
I select "Discard Changes"
expectedResults: the unsaved changes should be discarded
the previously saved details should remain unchanged

scenarios.title: View archived Locations
preconditions: archived and active Locations exist
actions: I select "Show Archived"
expectedResults: archived Locations should be displayed
the Location list should reflect the selected filter

scenarios.title: View inactive Locations
preconditions: active and inactive Locations exist
actions: I select "Show Inactive"
expectedResults: inactive Locations should be displayed
the Location list should reflect the selected filter

scenarios.title: Apply Show Archived and Show Inactive together
preconditions: active, inactive and archived Locations exist
actions: I select "Show Archived"
I select "Show Inactive"
expectedResults: the Location list should reflect both selected filters

scenarios.title: Verify unsaved changes when navigating away from the location form
preconditions: I am logged in as an Organization Administrator
I am on the Locations section
actions: I open the location form to create a new location or edit an existing location
I enter or modify the location details
I navigate away without clicking Create Location or Save
I confirm discarding the changes
expectedResults: a confirmation popup should appear asking whether to discard the unsaved changes
I should be navigated away from the location form
the unsaved changes should not be saved

scenarios.title: Verify that an archived location cannot be recreated
preconditions: I am logged in as an Organization Administrator
a location has already been created and archived
actions: I navigate to the Add Location form
I enter the same details as the archived location
I click the Create Location button
expectedResults: the application should prevent the creation of a duplicate location
the archived location should remain archived
